description: Paired target3 M1 source oracle. Replay only TotalStats.1.22.js:26-110,254-352. Gallery initializers always return 1 but can mutate missing maps; require already prepared maps and never call initializers. No cache writes or website helpers.
target: M1 Equipment properties and source-owner numerical gates

extractions.label: gear_properties
extractions.description: Replay thirteen normal gear contributions in native calculation order. Apply the Menagerie multiplier to non-attribute obols. Source: TotalStats.1.22.js:26-110,254-352, with the version 1.24 non-attribute obol update.

extractions.label: obol_raw_STR
extractions.expression: (() => { let total = 0; for (const row of idleon.engine.getGameAttribute("PixelHelperActor")[0].behaviors.getBehavior("ActorEvents_29")._ScrollCircleINFO[43]) if (row[0] === "STR") total += Number(row[3]); return total; })()
extractions.description: Combined personal/family Obol STR; row columns are collection passes, not base and upgrade.

extractions.label: obol_adjusted_STR
extractions.expression: ((() => { let total = 0; for (const row of idleon.engine.getGameAttribute("PixelHelperActor")[0].behaviors.getBehavior("ActorEvents_29")._ScrollCircleINFO[43]) if (row[0] === "STR") total += Number(row[3]); return total; })()) * (1 + (idleon.callFunction("GetTalentNumber", 1, 111) + 40 * idleon.callFunction("GamingStatType", "SuperBitType", 2, 0)) / 100)
extractions.description: Obol STR contribution after its source-owned attribute modifier.
